```{r tl-projects, echo=FALSE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)

projects <- read.xlsx("projects.xlsx") |>
  arrange(-Year, -Month)

month_abb <- c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun",
               "Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec")

html_entry <- function(row) {
  mon <- if (!is.na(row$Month)) month_abb[as.integer(row$Month)] else ""
  upcoming <- is.na(row$Link_1)

  # Title — link to first URL if available
  title_html <- if (!upcoming) {
    sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">%s</a>', row$Link_1, row$Title)
  } else {
    row$Title
  }

  # Upcoming badge
  badge_html <- if (upcoming) '<span class="tl-type-upcoming">Upcoming</span>\n' else ""

  # Entry class
  entry_cls <- if (upcoming) ' tl-upcoming' else ''

  # Links
  link_tags <- ""
  for (k in 1:3) {
    nm  <- row[[paste0("Link_", k, "_name")]]
    url <- row[[paste0("Link_", k)]]
    if (!is.na(nm) && !is.na(url)) {
      cls <- if (grepl("award", nm, ignore.case = TRUE)) ' class="tl-award"' else ''
      link_tags <- paste0(link_tags,
        sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank"%s>%s</a>', url, cls, nm))
    }
  }
  if (nchar(link_tags) > 0)
    link_tags <- paste0('<div class="tl-links">', link_tags, '</div>')

  # Summary
  summary_html <- ""
  if (!is.na(row$Summary) && nchar(row$Summary) > 0) {
    summary_html <- sprintf(
      '<button class="tl-toggle" onclick="toggleSummary(this)">Summary</button>\n<div class="tl-summary">%s</div>',
      row$Summary)
  }

  sprintf(
'<div class="tl-entry%s">
<div class="tl-date">%s<br>%s</div>
<div class="tl-card">
%s<div class="tl-title">%s</div>
<div class="tl-venue">%s</div>
%s
%s
</div>
</div>',
    entry_cls, mon, row$Year,
    badge_html, title_html, row$Venue,
    link_tags, summary_html
  )
}

raw_entries <- apply(projects, 1, function(x) html_entry(as.list(x)))

# Insert year dividers when the year changes
years <- projects$Year
output <- character()
prev_year <- NULL
for (i in seq_along(raw_entries)) {
  yr <- years[i]
  if (is.null(prev_year) || yr != prev_year) {
    output <- c(output, sprintf('<div class="tl-year-divider"><span>%s</span></div>', yr))
    prev_year <- yr
  }
  output <- c(output, raw_entries[i])
}

cat('<div class="tl-wrapper">\n', paste(output, collapse = "\n"), '\n</div>\n')
cat('<script>
function toggleSummary(btn) {
  const summary = btn.nextElementSibling;
  const isOpen  = summary.classList.contains("open");
  summary.classList.toggle("open", !isOpen);
  btn.classList.toggle("open", !isOpen);
}
</script>\n')
```
